title: AC1024 associative constrained datum-line node
scope: Decode the witnessed AC1024 version-0 AcConstrainedDatumLine profile with its null soft-pointer handle and bounded line geometry; preserve unsupported variants, incomplete groups and strict document-level refusal.

independentLayoutSource.layout: The peer's constrained-line branch reads a geometry handle, geometry-node ID (BL), point (3BD), and direction (3BD) for AcConstrainedDatumLine.

autodeskClass.meaning: A read-only, unbounded datum line in the owning associative 2D constraint group.

autodeskConstructor.meaning: Point and direction are relative to the owning group workplane; direction must be nonzero.

sections: Section 2, page 7: BL, 3BD and H primitive identities.
Section 2.13, pages 15–16: code 4 is a soft-pointer reference; code 5 is a hard-pointer reference.
odaSpecification.result: The specification establishes primitive and handle-code meanings; class-specific order comes from the pinned peer and same-input probe.

localRawProbe.method: Fork body and handle streams at the unknown-class boundary; read the pinned peer's line-node fields transactionally without advancing the parser's source streams.

handle.encoding: null soft-pointer handle; zero payload bytes

independentPeerNodeCount.result: The peer parses the group and reports 400 vector entries; its source explicitly inserts one empty placeholder before the 399 declared inline source nodes. libdxfrw reports 399/399 nodes decoded and the bounded node list complete.

crossSample.limitation: This is a second same-library source trace confirming the exact node profile; its later Vertical constraint group remains partial.

implementedTrace.result: The group decodes all 399/399 inline nodes, including DatumLine 412, then strict export preflight refuses because the associative graph is not serialized. No DXF was created.

limitations: This receipt covers the observed AC1024 version-0 null soft-pointer DatumLine profile only; non-null dependencies and other constrained-line classes remain raw.
The group is parsed, but no associative graph serializer/readback or consumer acceptance is established.
This receipt has no support-claim effect.

fields: DataKind::Line, geometry dependency field presence/code/null reference, geometry-node ID, point and direction.
The decoder accepts only a null soft-pointer handle for this observed DatumLine profile and requires finite point/direction coordinates with a nonzero direction.
implementation.failureBehavior: Wrong handle role, non-null dependency, truncated direction, zero direction or non-finite coordinates leave the node untyped/raw and the group partial; following OBJECT recovery is verified.
generatedControls: From-scratch null-soft-pointer profile checks body fields, explicit null-versus-absent handle state, and following implicit-point handle alignment.
Wrong handle role, non-null soft pointer, missing direction and zero direction remain raw while the following OBJECT is recovered.
implementation.strictExport: dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized remains active; the fully parsed source group is not emitted and no DXF is created.

realSourceNormal.result: The group parses 399/399 inline nodes and advances to strict associative-graph export refusal; no DXF was created.

realSourceAsan.result: Same node count and strict refusal; no AddressSanitizer diagnostic and no DXF was created.

nextAction: Probe and implement the observed AC1024 AcVerticalConstraint profile at architectural node 122; verify the same body/handle profile against civil node 840.
